semanticReview.finding: All four titles naturally identify calendar widgets on iPhone and iPad and upcoming events. No title promises completeness or instant updates.

Named layouts preserved in English with device-translation caveat. Medium event list versus larger list and separate small date/weather tile remain distinct. System add-widget actions described without inventing localized named layouts.
All four require a comparison on the actual iPad and do not infer iPad accounts/access/data from correct iPhone display.
All four preserve future start-time eligibility from selected calendars and exclusion of all-day and already-started events, including ongoing meetings.
All four distinguish a later eligible item beyond the finite visible rows from a missing nearest eligible event. They do not recommend moving/deleting appointments to make a row appear.
App-first checks, harmless owned test appointments, no account removal and no fixed Apple widget-refresh deadline preserved.
Weather summary is not automatic venue/hour forecast; empty upcoming list does not establish free time. Full calendar remains needed for all-day/ongoing commitments.
